note: Level 1 of 3. One requirement per item, checked by the model for every case. Deliberately generic: no item names a specific dosing trick, target value or education topic, so the testbed's held-out error types are not spelled out here.

items.text: Every medicine the patient is told to take is stated with its dose and how often to take it.

The advice does not tell the patient to stop a prescribed long-term medicine for good on their own judgement. (Pausing a medicine temporarily while contacting a clinician, as the document instructs, is not a problem.)
The document does not contradict itself (for example, it does not prescribe a medicine that another part of the same document says to avoid, or give two different doses for one medicine).
Every factual statement about a medicine or condition in the document is medically correct.
The part addressed to the patient is written in plain language, with medical terms explained.
Each monitoring item says what is measured and when.
The advice does not promise or guarantee a clinical outcome.

changes: general-v4-2 (2026-11-15, pilot P0 on train split): G02 no longer counts a temporary pause while contacting a clinician as stopping a medicine.
